problem: PE1 could exhaust its captured-work snapshot before PE0 captured an already DMA-complete missing BA frame, unnecessarily handing the later frame to ARM and invalidating the shortcut during software reorder recovery.
fix: Yield until PE0 finishes its known hardware batch or exposes the newly captured tail. Preserve all packet bytes and PN/SN while waiting. A full work ring or no remaining capture still uses ARM. Missing packets continue to use mac80211's existing reorder handling.
layout: Existing16KiB instruction boundary and request-ring address retained. minsize on pe_rx_work saves branch-layout space; no buffer or timeout increase.

verification.before: The old linked PE fails the new case: sequence0x124 is handed to ARM even though0x123 is DMA-complete in the same hardware batch.
verification.after: The linked PE waits, forwards0x123 then0x124, and preserves PN ordering and buffer ownership. Missing-frame and full-work-ring cases still hand off to ARM.
verification.legacy_fixture_limitation: test_pe_downlink_gather.py fails with both original and modified images. Its executor fixture does not publish context generation142 for the current dual-PE dispatcher, nor model the separate PE0 RPQ executor. The passing backpressure fixture exercises actual dual-PE handoff and seven-subframe payload ownership; the legacy failure is not claimed as a pass.

RAM_comparison.interpretation: No measurable throughput or overall offload-share improvement in this pair. The model proves the handoff defect; these runs do not establish that it causes most ARM fallback or hardware drops.
RAM_comparison.limits: Encrypted Mac Wi-Fi plus the simulated PON endpoint, not physical PON. RAM module reload and another idle5GHz peer prevent treating the pair as a controlled RF capacity measurement. A2.4GHz AP failed to resume after hot replacement and its explicit restart; cold startup must be checked.

downlink_latency_evidence: latency-sample-timeline.txt uses one bounded10ms sampler. During the stall the PON injector published/read pointers matched and Wi-Fi TXBD read caught write, while76-78 WPs remained outstanding and RPQ producer/consumer stayed at12. This excludes a pending injector doorbell and a PE completion-recycling backlog at that sample. It does not prove why the chip had not issued completion reports.

cold_boot.image_verification: Embedded PE exact; FIT configuration and payload signatures pass, bad signature rejected; sysupgrade payloads exact; uploaded image hash and sysupgrade-T pass. Flash reboot reached U-Boot before relay power cycle.
cold_boot.normal_radios: Both2.4GHz and5GHz APs start normally. Flash radio hash matches build; no RAM replacement or sampling module during this round.
cold_boot.remaining: Cold uplink offload share is much lower than the RAM pair; startup state and additional peer effects are not separated. Mac received MACID2 after another client took MACID1. This association is evidence for the next comparison, not a proven cause. Existing zero-retransmission runs do not prove elimination of intermittent losses.
cold_boot.cleanup: All simulated endpoints, test servers and observer modules removed, table220 policy rule and Mac test host route removed; default external route192.168.71.1/en5 retained. New Flash image remains installed.
